name: Contiocean
summary: Contiocean Environment Tech Group Co., Ltd. develops and sells marine environmental protection technology in China. Its products include exhaust gas cleaning systems that cut sulfur emissions, energy-saving devices that reduce fuel use, and clean-energy supply systems for ships, together with accommodation interiors and lashing gear for container and vehicle carriers. Customers are shipowners, ship managers and shipbuilders in Asia, Europe, the Americas and the Middle East. It was established in 2017 in Shanghai.
